description.en: Restriction of energy intake with intense fear of weight gain
description.hi: वजन बढ़ने के तीव्र डर के साथ ऊर्जा-सेवन का प्रतिबंध

mappingNote: ICD-11 Anorexia nervosa is 6B80 within the 6B80-6B85 feeding/eating family (bulimia 6B81, binge eating 6B82, ARFID 6B83, pica 6B84, rumination-regurgitation 6B85) (index 9.1.2, 9.2.2).
